rules: Fields both scorers agree on are adopted unchanged.
The first run's written rules apply: margins judged at normal viewing size; halo, title, rock and corner glyphs count as lettering, conservatively.
Watercolor soft edges are recorded but do not make an image flawed (ADR 0006 amendment 2); a painted frame still does.
Unrequested, prominent figures count as extra figures, as in the first run.
noFormFigure no/na disputes resolve to no; neither is a figure.

scores.notes: Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Icon-style plain gilded border: the storm clouds are cut off by a straight line leaving a gold band about 25px deep along the top edge and down the upper left and right edges, so it reads as a painted frame. Jesus stands mid-boat with arm outstretched, disciples clinging and bailing; the cross-nimbus has lines only, no glyphs.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Night sea with Peter at the gunwale (centre-left), one bare foot on the gunwale and the other touching the water, disciples gripping the boat at left and Jesus standing on the waves at right with a lamp-lit shore behind. Painted to all four borders, with no lettering in any corner.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. Painting reaches all four borders (only tiny paper-white flecks in the wash at upper left and right edges); no lettering anywhere.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: God appears only as a broad golden shaft of light entering from the upper left over dark swirling waters; zooming the light area shows only brushwork, no face or figure. Painting reaches all four borders with no marks in the corners.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. Otherwise wolf with lamb, leopard, goat, calf and lion with the child, a shepherd at right and a Judean hill village, painted to all four edges.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: A swirling shaft of light enters from the top center and spreads over dark, wind-tossed primeval waters. Zoomed into the light: no face, hands or human shape, only brushwork. The dark painting reaches all four edges and there are no marks in the corners.

Operator (matchesScene disputed): noFormFigure no/na: no figure either way; matchesScene takes the lower label. Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. Ink-and-watercolor fades to white paper at the left edge and bottom corners (style margin only); loose ink grass scribbles at bottom center and on the bottom-right rock read as vegetation, not lettering.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. Operator (matchesScene disputed): noFormFigure no/na: no figure either way; matchesScene takes the lower label. A: A solid gold border band frames the top, left and right edges. Operator (matchesScene disputed): noFormFigure no/na: no figure either way; matchesScene takes the lower label. Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: The centre is a vast mirror-still plane with cloud reflections, bounded by grassy shorelines at left, right and bottom-left; only faint straight pane seams mark it as glass, so at normal size it reads as a calm lake, against 'the sea is no more'. No people; two faint distant cities at the horizon; a tiny smudge near the bottom right (about x1090,y740) shows glyph-like shapes only under heavy contrast and is not legible at normal size.

Operator (noFormFigure disputed): noFormFigure no/na: no figure either way; matchesScene takes the lower label. Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. Ink-and-watercolor fades to white paper on all four borders (style margin only), with no lettering.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Fiery streaks rain from a radiant opening in the clouds (top center) onto two walled mud-brick cities and the palm-lined plain, and anonymous onlookers on the near ridge shield their heads. The radiance holds no figure or face, the painting reaches all edges and there is no lettering.

Operator (matchesScene disputed): noFormFigure no/na: no figure either way; matchesScene takes the lower label. Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Jonah sits hunched inside the ribbed, slick belly of the fish with seaweed strands and no opening, and God appears only through the setting. Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: A cursive signature-like scribble sits on the road below the Roman soldier's feet (bottom right). The central elder wears a gold halo, which makes him read as Jesus or a saint in a scene with no named figures, and the 'synagogue' is a cluster of Byzantine domed churches topped with crosses.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Saul (centre-left) staggers mid-stride with his hand raised against a beam of white light from the top centre, and his companions shield their eyes or crouch beside a laden donkey (right), with Damascus's walls behind. The beam contains no figure or face. Painted to all four edges, with no lettering.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Icon-style walled Bethel with the golden calf on a plinth, but its domes carry Christian crosses (upper left of city), making it a Byzantine church town in Elisha's day. Bald Elisha with staff walks toward the viewer away from the gate, and the huddled youths at the gate (centre left) are not jeering at him; the leader points left, away from him.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: The sea is not divided: a single huge wave rears on the right over rocky shallows, with no dry sea floor between two walls of water. Moses with staff and Israelites on the left shore and a fiery glow in the clouds (top center, no figure) match the request.

Operator (matchesScene disputed): noFormFigure no/na: no figure either way; matchesScene takes the lower label. A: A painted gold frame surrounds the whole picture on all four sides, which is a blocking border. Otherwise Moses raises his arm beside Aaron toward a rooting pig with a ring of Israelites and the tabernacle under a plain radiant cloud (no figure in it); the breastplate and tabernacle door carry no lettering. B: The whole picture sits inside a painted gold-leaf frame on all four sides, with a flat gold sky. Moses (left) raises his hand skyward rather than toward the pig, Aaron in breastpiece beside him, pig rooting center-right with a ring of Israelites; only a small white cloud over the tabernacle, no figure; breastpiece stones carry no lettering.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Ink-and-watercolor: Naomi is seated with the swaddled infant (center), Ruth in a rust-red cloak and Boaz with a staff stand at right, three women of Bethlehem are in the lamplit doorway and a basket is set aside. The bottom corners and the top-right sky fade softly to paper (style fade); no lettering.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Paul stands left of center in a stone lane with a scroll under his arm, terraced hills, storm clouds with golden light and distant passers-by; the scroll is blank and the left and top edges show soft watercolor fade to paper. Minor: the window lamp is lit and the tiny distant city (right) has a dome and minaret-like tower.

Operator (overall disputed): A cursive word is painted on the ground beside the veiled woman (bottom centre), confirmed at 2x. A: Fire and burning sulfur fall from a radiant break in dark cloud onto two walled mud-brick cities while small figures flee and shield their faces; the sky holds only flames and rays, with no figure for Yahweh, and the gold ground reaches every edge. A tiny brown cursive-like mark on the bare ground left of the veiled woman (bottom centre) reads like a scribbled word up close but may be dry grass. B: Icon-style plain with both walled cities burning under fireballs streaming from a radiant cloud burst at top center that holds no face or figure; however, a small cursive inscription (reads like "Shkes") is painted on the ground beside the crack at lower center, next to the veiled woman.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Ink-and-watercolor: the bottom-left corner fades softly to white paper, and the other edges are painted through. The child walks barefoot ahead with an open hand, the wolf and lamb, leopard and goat, calf and lion follow, and a shepherd watches at right; no lettering.

Operator (edges disputed): Watercolor washes reach the borders at normal size (informational; soft edges are not gated). A: Ink and watercolour: Jesus stands by the mast with his arm outstretched over calming water, and the disciples crouch at the gunwales, one bailing water (centre). The sky wash stops just short of the right border in the upper right, leaving a thin soft strip of paper-white; that is a style fade, not a frame. No signature or lettering. B: Ink-and-watercolor: Jesus stands by the mast (centre) with arm outstretched over a calming sea under breaking storm clouds, disciples crouched at the gunwales and one bailing with a scoop (centre-right). Wash is painted to all four borders; no lettering in corners.

Operator (overall disputed): Jonah sits just inside the fish's jaws rather than deep in the belly; he is clearly inside the fish (borderline). A: Wet, bearded Jonah sits hunched against the fleshy wall with the ribbed gullet behind him and seaweed strands; but fanged jaws at the left and the lip arc framing the picture put him inside an open mouth seen from outside, not the sealed dark belly requested. Yahweh named in the verse is not depicted; dark corners checked brightened, all edges painted, no lettering. B: Wet, bearded Jonah sits hunched against slick ribbed flesh with a dark throat-tunnel behind him, but a gaping jaw of large teeth fills the left third, so he reads as sitting in the fish's open mouth rather than the enclosed belly the scene asks for (no opening). No figure for God; dark paint reaches all edges, no lettering.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Ink-and-watercolor: Moses with staff stretches his hand toward a dry stony path between two curling walls of water (center right), Israelites behind on the left, pillar of cloud and fire at top center with no figure in it. Soft fade to paper at the bottom corners and right edge is the watercolor style; a distant town on the far right horizon is unrequested but minor.

Operator (edges disputed): Pale but painted at normal size (informational). A: The Shulammite stands alone among wild roses and lilies with her veil drawn back, gesturing toward the blossoms, with apple trees in bloom, an upright shepherd's staff at right and a distant stone village at left. Watercolor washes reach all four borders; a faint dark mark at bottom right on zoom is only leaf shadow, with no lettering. B: The Shulammite stands left of center, mouth open, gesturing toward wild roses and lilies, with blossoming trees, a stone village and a freestanding shepherd's staff at right. Soft watercolor fade to pale paper along the left edge and bottom corners (style-acceptable); a faint dark wash stroke in the foliage near the bottom right (about x 1075) is not legible as initials.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Ink-and-watercolor: under an olive tree an elder with a staff points toward a distant walled city, with a woman carrying a water jar, a family, a tethered donkey (left) and a Roman soldier at the road's edge (right). The top-right sky and bottom-right corner fade softly to paper (style fade); no lettering or signature.

Operator (edges disputed): The white is the light burst and pale sky at normal size (informational). A: Saul (center) raises his hand under a swirling burst of light that holds no figure, two companions shield their eyes (left), a third man and a laden donkey stand on the road (right), and walled Damascus sits on the horizon; painted to all edges, no lettering. Minor: the city skyline includes domes and a minaret-like tower. B: Saul mid-stride centre with arm raised under a swirling burst of light (no form in it), two companions shielding eyes at left, a third with a laden donkey at right, Damascus walls on the horizon; the city includes an anachronistic dome and minaret (right background). Small white-paper patches show at the left and top-right borders in the watercolor.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: The Shulammite stands with her veil drawn back, gesturing toward wild roses and lilies, with blossoming trees and a shepherd's staff (right) and a distant hill village (left) under soft afternoon cloud. The painting reaches all four edges and there is no lettering.

Operator (overall disputed): Walls fall, horns blow and the crowd shouts; the crowd runs toward the viewer rather than into the city, a direction slip (borderline). A: Ink-and-watercolor with a soft fade to white paper at the bottom-right corner (not by itself a flaw); walls collapse at center with priests blowing shofars at left and right, and Joshua with a spear in the foreground. The shouting crowd and the foreground men run toward the viewer, away from the falling wall and the city behind it, so it reads as people pouring out of Jericho rather than into the breach. B: Ink-and-watercolor fall of Jericho's wall in dust, with priests in blue blowing ram's horns on both sides and Joshua with a spear at right foreground. The shouting crowd faces and runs toward the viewer, away from the breach rather than into the city, and the paint fades softly to paper at bottom right.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Icon-style picture with a flat gold border band down the left and right sides, where the landscape stops in a straight line: a painted frame. Small glyph marks sit in the arms of Jesus's cruciform halo (top centre). Otherwise three kneeling soldiers cast dice over the garments below three crosses, with onlookers at right; the board above the cross is blank.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Icon-style gold sky with stylised clouds and soft rays over a basin of smooth, opaque cream ground ringed by hills and cypresses, reading as an empty seabed with no water. Not glassy, but no people or figures; clouds and rays checked with no face or figure; painted texture reaches every edge, no inscription.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Only one seraph (upper center) hovers with bare feet uncovered and its face still visible under the wing hood, and it holds tongs with a burning coal, the verse-6 moment. Isaiah with staff at lower left, smoke and the glowing sanctuary doorway behind match; no figure appears for the Lord, and wall carvings are decorative angels and palms with no lettering.

Operator (matchesScene disputed): noFormFigure no/na: no figure either way; matchesScene takes the lower label. A: Abraham raises the knife over a stone altar where Isaac lies on the wood, with bundled firewood and a staff at bottom left, a tent and well lower right and the sun rising over the ridge. One small departure: Isaac's hands are free and the cord only ties the wood, so he does not clearly look bound. Ink-and-watercolor fades to white paper at the upper left and right edges (style margin only), with no lettering. B: Abraham stands center with the knife raised overhead and his other hand on Isaac's chest; Isaac lies on wood over a stone altar, with the sunrise, tent and well at right and a firewood bundle and staff at lower left. Isaac is not bound (hands and feet free; the ropes only tie the wood), and the watercolor fades to pale paper at the top-left and bottom-left corners (style-acceptable).

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Icon-style: Peter steps from the boat with one foot on the waves toward a radiant Jesus (center-right), with the disciples in the boat at left. Jesus' cross-nimbus has three glyph-like letters in its arms (O/Ω-like marks at top and sides, upper right of center); the scene is set against a gold daytime sky with a lit city rather than night with dark clouds.

Operator (coherence, overall disputed): The splash ahead of the airborne Peter reads as motion shorthand. A: Bare-chested Peter leaps from the small boat clutching his coat (center left) while the beloved disciple stands in the boat pointing toward shore and four disciples haul a fish-heavy net in the foreground right; painted to all edges, no lettering. Minor: the splash is drawn ahead of him while he is still airborne, and the net-haulers sit in a second boat rather than the one he leaps from. B: Bare-chested Peter clutching his coat is airborne between the boats (centre-left) while a large impact splash already erupts on the water below and ahead of him, before he has entered it; beloved disciple points from the middle boat and others haul a full net in the foreground boat. Edges painted full, no lettering; the splash-before-entry may read as motion shorthand, hence uncertain.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Four many-eyed winged creatures (lion, man, ox, eagle) stand around an empty marble throne under a rainbow, with a misty glass floor in front; the throne is empty, with no figure, face or hands for God. The bottom corners fade to white paper under the wash in the watercolor style, and an unrequested gold chest sits on the glass (bottom centre); there is no lettering.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Naomi sits on a bench holding the swaddled infant, with Ruth in a red cloak, Boaz with a staff, a gleaning basket at their feet, a lamp lit in the doorway and three Bethlehem women at right. The gold sky and landscape run to all four edges, with no halos, lettering or corner marks.

Operator (matchesScene, overall disputed): Four haloed winged angels sit by the placed thrones; the plan seats only the fiery presence. Counted as extra figures, as the first run counted an unrequested chariot army (borderline). A: The central seat of the Ancient of Days is only a tall flame with white light and rays above burning wheels (top centre), with no face or silhouette even on zoom. Four winged, haloed angels set and sit beside thrones (upper left and upper right); they are unselected heavenly attendants, akin to the ministering assembly. Daniel looks up at lower left with Babylon behind; painted to all edges with no lettering. B: The Ancient of Days appears only as a white-cored flame above burning wheels (top centre), with no face or figure in it, and Daniel looks up at lower left. But five haloed, winged angels stand or sit beside the empty thrones in the clouds (top left and top right), a host the scene leaves out, and the sky behind is gold rather than night.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Upper centre: the Ancient of Days is drawn as a seated white-robed figure, with outlined head, shoulders, knees and robe folds and both hands resting on the armrests of a flaming wheeled throne. Daniel on a Babylon rooftop at left looks up; the edges are fully painted and his scroll case is plain.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: The center of the image reads as a reflective blue bay or lake between rolling hills, so a reader sees a sea where the verse says the sea is no more. Watercolor fades to white paper at the left/right edges and bottom corners (style, not itself a flaw); light shafts and clouds contain no figures.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Job, in a torn, ash-stained tunic and blue cloak, stands bare-headed with a staff on a heap of ash and potsherds while a dust whirlwind with lightning and an iridescent glow sweeps in at upper left; zooming the storm shows no face or figure. The icon-style gold sky at right and the city walls on both sides are painted to all four borders, with no lettering.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Abraham raises a knife over Isaac, who lies roped on the wood atop a stacked-stone altar on the rocky ridge, with a tent and well far right. The bright clouds hold no figure, the painting reaches every edge and there is no lettering.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Icon-style Ezekiel stands left in a valley strewn with skulls and bones under a plain gold sky with no figure for God; painted to every edge, and the tablet is seen edge-on and blank. Instead of lifting an arm to prophesy, he is writing on a tablet with a stylus, his other hand open toward the bones.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Daniel stands unharmed in a round stone pit among five lions resting with closed mouths, a shaft of light falls from above (no angelic figure), Darius leans on the far rim (upper left, standing rather than kneeling and drawn oversized in icon style), and two guards stand at a distance. The gold ground reaches every edge; small curved pebble strokes at the far left edge look faintly like numerals up close but read as ground texture.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Moses and Aaron (blank-stone breastplate, plain headband) stand foreground left, a pig roots at center and Israelites stand in a loose group at right. Above the tabernacle, God's presence is only a plain glowing cloud with rays (top center), with no figure. Painted to all edges, no lettering; Moses gestures with an open hand rather than raising his arm toward the pig.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: A barefoot child (centre) leads a young lion on a cord with an open hand, beside a wolf with a lamb, a leopard lying with a goat and two calves, with a distant shepherd at left and a Judean hill village and walled gate in morning light. Painted to all four edges, with no lettering or halos.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Moses with staff (left) and Aaron in ephod and plain-stoned breastplate stand before a pig rooting in the scrub, with Israelites ringed behind and tents and tabernacle beyond; Moses' outstretched hand awkwardly overlaps Aaron's chest rather than clearly pointing at the pig. The cloud over the tabernacle is a plain pink-white cloud with no figure; the gate panels are ornamental, not lettering, and the edges are fully painted.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Ink-and-watercolor: an old man lies on a woven mat in the foreground with eyes closed and hands folded, four mourners sit with bowed heads, a staff leans against a tent at left, flock grazes at right, mud-brick dwellings behind. Bottom corners fade softly to paper (watercolor style); no lettering.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: A pale signature-like inscription ('s..l.') is painted on the rock at bottom right (about x1030-1080, y750-760). Above Isaiah there is only one seraph, a tangled knot of wings with two half-veiled faces, and it carries tongs with a burning coal from verse 6. The temple hall walls also open onto rocky hills, cypresses and city walls; the central radiance has no figure in it.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: A raised gold painted border frames the whole icon on all four sides (visible at every corner).
